context:
# Goal
Souji round 13 only. Declared C1 calibration (lowest score 7): replace trust in certification relays with an executable evidence validator rejecting mismatched installed hashes, shared fragment ownership, missing evidence paths, and false success. C2 operability: close Q8 per-target staging/digest timeout and FIFO defect in installed quarantine tool without granting deletion certification. C3 coverage: safely demonstrate git repo structure under /var/tmp and admit an F2 entry grounded in opened S005/S006; no live deletion.
# Contract
Lane root: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin. ALL filesystem paths absolute. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>. Your only write set is explicitly assigned files plus your own report trailer; no shared bookkeeping writes. Never edit operator-authored census/operator-sweep-20261019/, verifier/aggregator lessons, fleet repo or sibling repos. Leaf: no delegation. L1 owns planner seat and integration. Read lane AGENTS.md and relevant QUALITY criteria; current non-author lesson is corpus/lessons/round-12-verifier-spotcheck.md. Certification remains OFF. Do not claim independent non-author status. Do not build/lint/test/format or execute tools mid-flight; author runnable artifacts and identify exact final checks for L1, unless your assigned work explicitly opens an external source (not verification). No commits by seats. Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; you may install/upgrade helpful tools via official channels with full privilege, and record tool/version/channel/reason. Never use cd; absolute paths and git -C only. No GUI. No credentials. Read-only probes must not scan content of operator sweep or secrets. All fixture writes strictly mktemp under /var/tmp with trap cleanup; git commits maintenance.auto=false and explicit -C.
# Findings
Baseline HEAD 31984f4. Operator sweep is sole initial untracked path. Q15 withdrawn by Q16; K5 HELD; no /dev/shm exception. Prior defect: r11 cert-16 relay overwritten, verdict bytes differed installed; r12 K5 claimed nonexistent fixture. Each report must cite exact observed code lines and distinguish inference from facts.
